reviews.text: We were seen by two different vets. One was sympathetic and genuinely there to help the suffering animal, the other had a completely different agenda which involved making as much money as possible out of a very difficult situation.

First off they should have told me the price upfront but never did so after the procedure I had to scrape the money up from friends and family. Took my Welsh Terrier for its six monthly check up. Everyone was so kind and was seen at the appointed time. The vet was very informative and listened to my concerns. Definitely satisfied with my visit.

Disappointing experience - would not recommend
I rarely leave reviews, but our most recent visit left me feeling I had to share this.
The reception staff were genuinely lovely, polite and helpful. Unfortunately, the same cannot be said for the vet we saw.
During what was supposed to be a health check for our puppy, the appointment felt brief and rushed. More concerningly, the vet mentioned they are not fond of dogs - which is deeply unsettling to hear in a veterinary setting. Our puppy had a visible bite on his leg that we specifically flagged during the appointment. The vet gave it a cursory glance, told us it was fine, and sent us home with no treatment and no advice whatsoever.
The bite continued to worsen and distressing our pupppy. We ended up taking him to Pets at Home later on the very same day as seeing the vet, where staff immediately identified it as a mosquito bite that was causing him significant discomfort. They provided proper guidance, antiseptic treatment, and advice on dressing the wound to prevent him from licking it and risking infection - all of which should have come from our vet.
I've attached a photo of the bite that was completely disregarded. It speaks for itself.
We will be moving to a different vet. A professional who openly admits to disliking animals should not be practising veterinary medicine, and no pet owner should leave an appointment worse off than when they arrived.

I cannot thank the team at Medivet Dulwich enough for the incredible care they’ve provided for my cat, Simba. From the moment we walk through the door, the reception staff is so welcoming, and the vets are incredibly patient and gentle. They always take the time to explain treatments clearly and truly care about Simba’s wellbeing.

Simba’s health has unfortunately declined recently, and Adam’s guidance has been invaluable. He is incredibly knowledgeable, thorough, and honest, yet delivers every piece of news with genuine kindness. He handles Simba gently, always minimising his stress during visits. I am deeply grateful for Adam's professionalism and compassion as we navigate Simba's health journey.

I highly recommend this practice to any pet parent!
Our cats have always received an excellent service here, and our new kitten Stilton was warmly welcomed on his first visit.  As usual Adam was very helpful and thorough

I’ve had all positive experiences at this location. The staff are great, very accommodating and friendly. Shout out to Adam, who has given my 2 boys an all star treatment every time. They’ve both undergone some surgery and procedures at this location, and I know they are in the best hands with Adam. He’s very sweet with them and talks me through everything I need to know. Truly the best vet we’ve ever been to.

I used this vets as they were close to home but I found them to be hit and miss on standards of care. For example, they struggled to do a basic procedure such as blood pressure testing yet never seemed to update on training or equipment to make this process easier. Our dog had a complex condition which I think they were out of their depth with and they let us down terribly in the end.
Lovely funny staff. Clean and welcoming

Highly recommend this practice. I've been with them for 6 years now and have stayed with them even after moving out of the area. They have performed surgeries and many informative diagnosis on both my cat and dog. I feel very lucky to have complete faith and trust specifically in my vet Inga. The staff are always friendly, welcoming, professional and helpful.

Medivet Dulwich were very supportive to me and my cat: provided ongoing care for my cat’s medical conditions; provided me as the owner with emotional support; worked well together (Vetinarian and Nurse) to cats claws. My elderly feline is living her best life and the team are very supportive.

We couldn’t be happier with the care our dog Indiana has received at Medivet. From day one, the team has provided truly five-star support, helping us diagnose and manage Indy’s allergies with real expertise and attention.

What stands out most is how much Indiana genuinely loves coming in—he’s always excited to see the staff and vets, which says everything about the warmth and care they show. Adam and Inga have been fantastic in guiding us through every step, from finding the right behaviourist to managing his ongoing treatment and keeping up with vaccinations and boosters.

They’ve also made dealing with our insurance incredibly smooth and stress-free, which has been a huge help. We always feel well-informed and supported, with clear, expert advice on how to give Indy the best possible quality of life.

We’re so grateful for everything they’ve done and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Medivet to anyone looking for compassionate, knowledgeable veterinary care.

It was our first trip to the vet with our newly adopted cat who unfortunately had worms. The vet Adam was incredibly kind and helped put our cat at ease quickly with his treatment. He also offered lots of advice on diet. Very relaxed cat on the way home. Thank you!

Updated 22/05 - another wonderful experience with Adam. He puts our cat at ease incredibly quickly. And he was very patient with him climbing all the cupboards. Thank you so much Adam
Trixie, like most pets, doesn’t enjoy trips to the vet, but Adam has a lovely way with her that makes these essential visits easier. Thanks Adam ☺️
Great vets! All the staff are friendly and professional and Adam's amazing!
The Dulwich team has always been very friendly, helpful and professional. The newle-renovated premises are an added bonus.

Please do not bring your cat here for a dental. They simply do not have the expertise or even the facilities to perform these. My cat had some teeth out in November without any imaging done before or after as they did not have a dental x-ray. Six months later I had to pay for her to have another dental with a different practice who actually have the equipment to handle the complexities of veterinary dentistry. Why did she need another dental? Because Adam, a practice partner, left roots for the teeth he removed and the teeth he didn’t remove actually needed to come out all along because of resorptive lesions which are often only seen on x-rays. I am sure they will come up with a variety of excuses to avoid responsibility however they advertised their £750 dental package to be fully comprehensive without highlighting the major disadvantage of not performing any imaging. My cat went on to have weeks of infection due to the roots being left behind, which actually benefitted Medivet Dulwich as they prescribed one antibiotic after another making even more money from their negligence and incompetence. Since their refurbishment, they have installed a new dental x-ray machine however the point is these vets lacked the decency to be transparent about their limitation as a practice when dealing with my cat’s care. Where else will they choose profit over pets? I went on to submit a complaint regarding this and more, and I received a response from Inga, the other practice partner, only justifying their reasoning. Complaints are meant to be independently reviewed by a practice manager as a way of improving care, not simply rebutted by feigning clinical ambiguity.
Amazing service as always but Igna and the team! Aura and Harley love you guys and always so thorough!

Adam has been brilliant with our dog who has become really anxious recently. He spent time really trying to work out what was going on- as well as trying to make our dog as comfortable as possible. Huge thank you

When I have had to use the emergency vets at Beckenham and Camberwell they were also absolutely amazing and so patient, no matter what time of day or night.

They also deal with all insurance claims quickly and painlessly.
Highly recommended.

The team at Medivet Dulwich are the best. They do a wonderful job in looking after our toy poodles, Tuva and Mina who can be very anxious about going to the vet full stop!

I had a really positive experience at Medivet a few weeks ago with my dog Stevie, who is usually extremely nervous at the vet. She usually needs to be muzzled for vaccinations as she gets so anxious.

I have always been happy with Medivet Dulwich in the past but yesterday I took a new cat that we had adopted for a 2nd dose vaccination. I had booked this appointment online and had given details of what vaccine had been used by the cat charity vet for the first dose. I explained in the online form that the appointment was for the second dose.
When I arrived I was told by the vet that they use different vaccines which aren’t compatible so the cat would need to be completely re-vaccinated (two doses) using their vaccine.
Had I been told this in advance I could have booked with a vet who did have the same vaccine and just had the time and cost of one visit instead of two.
